body.condition: For every deterministic \(\delta_n\downarrow0\), the fixed-stratum randomized-control empirical process of \(\nabla_\theta L((X,Y);\theta)-\nabla_\theta L((X,Y);\theta_n)\) is \(o_{\mathbb P_n}(1)\) uniformly over \(\|\theta-\theta_n\|\le\delta_n\).
